description_en: Adds one or more materials to an online editing project
description_zh: 将一个或多个素材添加到剪辑工程中
kebab_example: aliyun vod add-editing-project-materials --project-id afa31b483b5c41609185de0e1b790579 --material-ids d3251979f9fd41f2acb29ccda5a6f772 --material-type video --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddEditingProjectMaterials

parameters.help_en:
The material IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). A maximum of 10 material IDs are supported.
When you associate multiple materials, ensure that all materials are of the same type and correspond to the MaterialType value
parameters.help_zh:
素材ID，多个素材以逗号（,）分隔；最多支持10个素材ID。
关联多个素材时应保证多个素材均为同一类型，且与MaterialType取值对应
parameters.name: material_ids

parameters.help_en:
The material type. Valid values:
video: video.
audio: audio-only.
image: image
parameters.help_zh:
素材类型。取值：
video：视频。
audio：纯音频。
image：图片
parameters.name: material_type
